show.description: After losing his eyesight in an accident, billionaire Karan Malhotra is abandoned by his girlfriend and pushed to the edge of despair. Aradhya, a strong-willed woman hiding her own powerful identity, saves him and agrees to a contract marriage to become his “eyes.” As Karan battles betrayal, a murderous stepbrother, and corporate conspiracies within Malhotra Jewels, the fake marriage slowly turns into real love while buried secrets about Aradhya, their past, and their child begin to surface.
